001: Haoran, have you planned out your schedule for next week?
Not yet. There's so much to do that I can't seem to sort it all out.
Do you want me to help you prioritize things by importance?
That would be great. I've been worried about not knowing where to start.
Let's lock in the most urgent client meeting first, and the rest will be easier to handle.
That makes sense. I'll go ahead and confirm the meeting time right away.
002: Zixuan, do you have time this afternoon to join the project discussion?
I have a conference call at three, but I should be free after that.
Then let's schedule the discussion for four thirty. Does that work for you?
Sure, four thirty is fine on my end.
Great, I'll book the meeting room first and then send you the invitation.
Thanks for your help. I'll be there on time.
003: Jingyi, it looks like the report you submitted last week hasn't been updated yet?
Sorry, my schedule has been so packed these past few days that I haven't been able to get to it.
I understand, but we need this report by tomorrow morning.
Then I'll work overtime tonight to finish it and send it to you first thing tomorrow.
Thanks for your effort. Next time, if you're overwhelmed, let me know in advance.
Okay, I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for the reminder.
004: Tianyou, what does your schedule look like after you get back from the business trip?
The morning after I return, I have to report to the boss, and there's a training session in the afternoon.
Can you still make it to the department meeting on Wednesday?
What time is the meeting? If there's a conflict, I'll adjust my schedule.
It's at two on Wednesday afternoon. It shouldn't conflict.
Good, I'll make sure to keep that time open.
005: Jiaqi, have you finalized your client visit plan for next week?
Yes, I've scheduled one for Tuesday and one for Thursday.
Can you attend the team meeting on Friday morning?
Friday morning works for me. I don't have anything else scheduled.
Great, I'll send you the meeting materials in advance.
Got it. I'll take a look at them beforehand.
006: Haoran, have you been working overtime a lot lately? You look pretty tired.
Yeah, we're trying to catch up on the project, so my schedule is packed.
If you keep going like this, you're going to burn out. You need to rest properly.
I know, but I really can't put down what I'm working on right now.
How about I take on some of the work for you?
I'd really appreciate that. Let me first sort out the most urgent tasks.
007: Zixuan, have you confirmed your interview arrangement for tomorrow morning?
Yes, it's at ten in the morning, at the head office building.
Make sure to leave early then. The morning rush hour traffic is really bad over there.
Yeah, I'm planning to leave forty minutes early.
Good. Remember to let me know how it goes after the interview.
No problem. I'll tell you the result as soon as I find out.
008: Jingyi, how's the progress on your current project?
We're still waiting on the supplier's quote, so it might be delayed a few days.
Will that affect our delivery date next month?
It shouldn't. I've already built in some buffer time.
That's good, but you should still keep a close eye on it.
Don't worry. I'll follow up on the progress every day.
009: Tianyou, have you arranged your training sessions for next week?
Yes, I have one on Tuesday afternoon and another on Thursday afternoon.
Can you make some time to attend the welcome party for new employees on Friday?
I'm free on Friday afternoon, so I can make it.
Great, I'll add you to the attendee list.
Thanks, I'll be there on time.
010: Jiaqi, how's your work pace lately? Are you adjusting well?
It's okay, but there are a bit too many meetings, so it's hard to manage my time.
You could try scheduling all your meetings in a fixed time block.
That's a good idea. I'll give it a try next week.
Also, remember to set aside some time for focused work.
You're right. I'll readjust my schedule.
